title: Business Administration Apprentice
description:
Business Administration Apprentice - Eastleigh 23,500 Full-Time - Office based

Are you leaving school or college and looking to start your career in a professional office environment where you can learn key skills for the future?

We are seeking a motivated Business Administration Apprentice to join a successful electrical and mechanical services business in the Eastleigh area. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience while working towards a recognised qualification, and the development opportunities are fantastic.

Duties include
- Providing general administrative support to the office team
- Help prepare and format documents, letters, and administrative paperwork
- Support record-keeping for quotes, job details, and job documentation
- Answering calls and responding to emails
- Assist with updating calendars for site visits, meetings, and appointments.
- Updating company records and spreadsheets
- Filing, scanning and preparing project documentation
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the business

Training & Development
- Attend college one day per week as part of your apprenticeship
- Receive full training and support from an experienced team
- Learn to use AutoCAD and develop technical drawing skills
- Build valuable administrative, IT and business skills

What We're Looking For
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- A reliable and professional approach

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Customs & Road Freight Coordinator
description:
Position: Road Freight & Customs Operator

Location: Eastleigh, Southampton Freight Forwarding Customs Road Freight

Hours: Monday - Friday -8:30am - 17:00pm (Hybrid)

Salary up to 30,000

Are you an experienced Customs Operator with a background in Road Freight Operations and looking for your next step?

We're currently working with an established specialist logistics and freight business in Eastleigh that is looking to add an experienced operator to its Freight team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who has a grounding in customs clearance across both imports and exports, but who is also keen to broaden their knowledge of road freight and develop their career further within freight forwarding.

You don't need to be an expert across every area already - the client is particularly interested in someone with the right attitude, willingness to learn and potential to develop.

The Role

You'll primarily work within the Road Freight department, managing a varied range of shipments and supporting customers throughout the process.

A significant part of the role will involve customs, so strong experience in customs clearance is important. Over time, there will also be the opportunity to develop your knowledge across other areas of freight forwarding and potentially train in an additional mode.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing day-to-day road freight shipments
- Handling import and export customs clearance
- Preparing and checking customs and shipping documentation
- Liaising with customers, hauliers, suppliers and other stakeholders
- Coordinating shipments from booking through to delivery
- Dealing with customs queries and resolving operational issues
- Ensuring shipments are processed accurately and efficiently
- Supporting the wider freight forwarding operation
- Developing your knowledge of road freight and other modes over time

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within freight forwarding
- Solid experience with customs clearance
- Knowledge of both import and export customs processes

Road freight experience would be advantageous, but it isn't essential.

If you have strong customs experience and are looking for an opportunity where you can build on that knowledge and develop further within freight forwarding, we'd be keen to speak with you.
- Training and support available
- A role where attitude and potential are valued alongside experience
- Long-term career development opportunity

WR Logistics are a leading recruitment partner for the logistics and supply chain industry, recruiting across the UK, Europe, and the USA for permanent opportunities.

WR Logistics is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive - Eastleigh - £35,000 - £40,000 per annum

Due to ambitious growth and expansion, an exciting opportunity has become available for a hungry Internal Sales Executive to join a well-established electrical distributor based in Chandler's Ford.

The Internal Sales Executive will join a fast-paced and ambitious business, providing exceptional pre and post-sales support to customers within the electrical sector. This role combines business development with account management, with the aim of driving business growth and strengthening customer relationships.

Candidates must have a background in the electrical industry, ideally with experience in electrical distribution, and possess a good understanding of electrical products and their applications.

Main Duties of the Internal Sales Executive:
- Develop and manage a portfolio of existing accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities, expanding the customer base.
- Provide sales support and expert advice on electrical product specifications and applications.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships, addressing product-related enquiries.
- Collaborate with sales, procurement, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions.
- Maintain a proactive approach, ensuring KPIs are met and customer queries are handled efficiently.

Key Competencies of the Internal Sales Executive:
- Previous internal sales, business development, or account management experience.
- A strong electrical background, with knowledge of electrical products and ideally experience working for an electrical wholesaler or distributor.
- Robust sales and negotiation skills, with a drive to close deals and generate business.
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a customer-centric approach.
- Well-structured and organised, able to prioritise work and manage time effectively.
- Proficiency in CRM software, Microsoft Office, and relevant sales tools.
- A proactive team player with a positive attitude and a polite, friendly manner.

The Internal Sales Executive role is an exciting full-time, permanent opportunity working Monday to Friday, 08:00 am - 05:00 pm.

Our client offers an annual salary of up to £40 K, depending on experience, plus a profit share bonus, healthcare cover and increased annual holiday entitlement with length of service.

If you have an electrical background, enjoy building customer relationships and are looking to further your sales career within a fast-paced, dynamic and growing electrical distributor, please APPLY NOW!

title: Project Administrator
description:

Job Type: Full-time, permanent
